canonical_statement: Causal relationships and structures are preserved under certain transformations between spacetimes.

attributions.surface_quote: the chronological as well as the causal futures and pasts of points are preserved

canonical_statement: The causal character of curves and time separation functions are maintained under isometric transformations.

attributions.surface_quote: the causal character of locally Lipschitz curves is preserved, as is the length of causal curves
